name: customer-support
description: Support responses evaluated for required facts, safe scope, and concise communication.

tasks.prompt: A customer asks for a refund 10 days after purchase. Policy: refunds are available within 30 days for unused products. Reply in two sentences or fewer, mention the 30-day window, and ask whether the product is unused.
A customer says only: `I need help with my order.` Ask one concise follow-up question that requests the order number.
